findings.issue: Three new names omit the right-hand side of the relation they prove, so the conclusion is not recoverable from the name: `twoRank_le_of_surjective` (`twoRank H ≤ twoRank G`, direction unstated), `range_elementaryTwoQuotientMap_ker_subtype_le` (line 67; the bound is `≤ LinearMap.ker (elementaryTwoQuotientMap f)`), and `card_elementaryTwoQuotient_of_forall_sq_eq_one` (Basic.lean:396; the value is `Nat.card G`).

summary: Several introduced names do not describe their conclusions: a `mem_ker_…` name on an `= 0` statement, `toClassGroup` for a map that does not land in the class group, `twoRank_classGroup` where the repo already spells that definition `classGroupTwoRank`, and three names that omit the right-hand side of their relation. No notation is introduced.
